authorization: Root GO limited to IO/picker androidDeviceTest probes, known provider descriptor calibration and controls after third-device final input hashes.
source_state: Held uncommitted diagnostic sources, refrozen after edit; not immutable candidate evidence.
algorithm: Only REG/FIFO reference identities are admitted after actual known-handle fdinfo.ino equals fstat.st_ino and is nonzero.
Snapshot own numeric fds, duplicate each, strictly parse its required unsigned ino; only different ino is excluded before stat.
Same-ino candidates still require real fstat st_dev+st_ino equality. No mount-ID comparison, path exclusion, EACCES suppression, permission change or synthetic native identity.
Only duplication IOException with EBADF cause is ignored; malformed/missing/duplicate fdinfo, failed native calls and close failures still fail. Every owned duplicate and metadata reader closes.
calibration: Caller File references: actual PFD compared against path stat; native FIFO controls validate both endpoints.

IO real FileProvider source PFD is REG-calibrated before transfer; real reliable-pipe PFD is FIFO-calibrated and its stat/fdinfo metadata is reported by the provider. Failures close owned source/pipe resources.

Picker DocumentsProvider validates actual regular descriptor before transfer; base FileProvider reference is additionally calibrated through an actual received read-only descriptor closed before the library operation.
positive_controls: Both probes retain exact known-open detection and unchanged offsets, now across two different files including an unlinked-but-open file.
IO real FIFO pair must count2, then1, then0, across repeated scans.
Two additive pure parser device tests cover zero, unsigned64max, missing key, duplicate key, empty, signed, nondecimal, internal whitespace and overflow.
limitations: Compile and execute the focused native and parser controls before any whole-suite rerun; these static checks do not establish permission or a passing probe.
Calibration scope is these task-owned regular files/FIFO providers, not arbitrary filesystems/custom getattr implementations.
Actual hardlink EACCES test is unchanged and remains a distinct unresolved setup/policy limitation.
Historical third diagnostic failures and prior source receipts remain preserved.
